clues: This town is the chief town of its borough, in a vale in the north of its land. It is the second town of its county.
This town sits in the rain shade of high hills to its west. It gets as little rain as the most dry parts of its land.
This town was made a city in 2022. The grant came by royal writ, as part of a queen's grand jubilee year.
This town is known far and wide for horse racing. Its rail works of old are famed as well.
More than three hundred thousand folk live in this town's wide borough. It links by road and rail to towns all round.
